title: Cosmic Egg Serpent
description: A large cracked white egg with a smiling face and galaxy-like eyes sits atop a brick pillar emerging from dark turbulent water. A green snake covered in smiley faces is coiled around the egg, its head emerging to the right. The surreal night scene features a fiery red and purple cosmic sky with floating smiley faces, hearts, TikTok logos, and text elements like 'viral chain' and 'original fusion'.
prompt: Surreal scene of a giant cracked white egg with a smiling face and cosmic eyes resting on a brick pillar in dark stormy water. A green snake covered in smiley face emojis is coiled around it. Night sky with swirling purple nebulae, fiery orange clouds, floating smiley faces, hearts, and social media symbols. Text elements like viral chain and original fusion visible. Psychedelic and whimsical atmosphere.
